role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
hero_summary_zh: 杰奇洛是他们自己最好的朋友。不满足于只用烈火惩治敌人，双生龙还将他们冻在原地，接受烈焰焚身。当敌人浑身着火时，他们转过身去吐出液态的火焰，对敌方建筑造成巨大的伤害。
hero_summary_en: Jakiro is their own best friend. Not content to merely punish enemies with fire, the twins freeze them in place to force them to stand there and burn. With foes aflame, they turn to inflicting massive damage on enemy structures with their liquid fire.

abilities.name: jakiro_dual_breath
abilities.description_zh: 杰奇洛对面前的敌人先后喷出寒冰和火焰。寒冰吐息减速敌人，火焰吐息对敌人造成持续伤害。
abilities.description_en: An icy blast followed by a wave of fire launches out in a path in front of Jakiro. The ice slows enemies, while the fire delivers damage over time.
notes_zh: 最远能伤害1025距离外的单位。
不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。
notes_en: Can hit units up to 1025 range away.
Has a %fire_delay% second interval between each breath.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

abilities.name: jakiro_ice_path
abilities.description_zh: 在杰奇洛前方制造一条冰封路径，对触及到的敌人造成伤害并眩晕。
abilities.description_en: Creates a path of ice that stuns and damages enemies that touch it.
notes_zh: 冰封路径消失后眩晕效果也会消失。
notes_en: It takes %path_delay% seconds for the path to reach its full extent.
The stun is removed once Ice Path is destroyed.
facet_text_en: Jakiro can choose to destroy the Ice Path at any time, stunning and damaging enemies again.
Ice Path lasts longer and detonates upon expiration, dealing damage and stunning enemies a second time. Ice Path can be manually detonated early.
facet_text_zh: 杰奇洛可以选择随时摧毁冰封路径，再次对敌人造成<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>和伤害。
冰封路径的持续时间变长，并且结束时会引爆，再次对敌人造成伤害和眩晕。冰封路径可以手动提前引爆。

abilities.name: jakiro_liquid_fire
abilities.description_zh: 杰奇洛的火焰燃烧效果范围内的敌人，并降低他们的攻击速度。和液态冰共用冷却时间。
abilities.description_en: Jakiro burns his enemies in an area of effect with fire added to his attack, while slowing their attacks. Shares a cooldown with Liquid Frost.
notes_en: Works on both units and buildings.

shard_loc.en: Jakiro's Liquid Fire has no mana cost and no longer shares a cooldown with Liquid Frost.
shard_loc.zh: 杰奇洛的液态火没有魔法消耗，并且不再和液态冰共用冷却时间。

abilities.name: jakiro_liquid_ice
abilities.description_zh: 杰奇洛的攻击使他的敌人受寒，减缓其移动速度，持续%duration%秒，并且被杰奇洛的攻击和其他技能击中后承受额外伤害。这个效果对建筑无效。与液态火共用冷却时间。
abilities.description_en: Jakiro chill his enemies with ice added to his attack, slowing movement for %duration% seconds and increasing damage taken from Jakiro's attacks and abilities. This effect does not apply to buildings. Shares a cooldown with Liquid Fire.

shard_loc.en: Jakiro's Liquid Frost has no mana cost and no longer shares a cooldown with Liquid Fire.
shard_loc.zh: 杰奇洛的液态冰没有魔法消耗，并且不再和液态火共用冷却时间。

abilities.name: jakiro_double_trouble
abilities.description_zh: 杰奇洛攻击时两个头都会发动攻击，不过每个头造成的伤害减少。
abilities.description_en: Jakiro's attacks launch an attack from each head, but deal less damage each.
notes_zh: 第二次攻击无视伤害格挡。
notes_en: The second attack ignores Damage Block.
facet_text_en: Jakiro deals more damage with his double attacks.
facet_text_zh: 杰奇洛的双重攻击造成更高伤害。

abilities.name: jakiro_macropyre
abilities.description_zh: 杰奇洛释放出烈焰风暴，烈焰风暴作用范围很宽，并持续数秒。烈焰风暴每秒都会对作用范围内的敌人造成伤害。
abilities.description_en: Jakiro exhales a wide line of lasting flames, which deals damage per second to any enemy units caught in the fire.
notes_zh: 被烈焰焚身击中后离开区域还将额外受到%linger_duration%秒伤害效果。
notes_en: Units hit by Macropyre will continue to be affected after they leave the area for %linger_duration% additional seconds.

scepter_loc.en: Increases Macropyre duration and causes it to deal Pure damage. Jakiro emits two walls of ice along the edges of the Macropyre that slow any enemies trying to cross them by %ice_edge_movement_slow%%%.
scepter_loc.zh: 提升烈焰焚身的持续时间，并且变为纯粹伤害。杰奇洛会在烈焰焚身边缘放出两道冰墙，对试图穿过的所有敌人减速%ice_edge_movement_slow%%%。

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_jakiro
talents_raw.desc_loc: Increases both stun and path duration.

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_jakiro_3
talents_raw.name_loc: +{s:bonus_pct_health_damage}% Liquid Frost and Fire Max Health Damage
talents_raw.desc_loc: Deals +{s:bonus_pct_health_damage}% of the target's max health as damage. This damage does not apply to Buildings.
